verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an email-sending API, but the evidence pack documents no bulk-send or batch API. It shows only single-message SendEmail types (simple, raw, templated) and no batch management of identities, templates or other resources. Domain-level identity verification, receipt rules and community reports of sending mailing lists through SES are adjacent features or user-side tooling, not a documented bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
